jobs.title: System Architect
jobs.description_text: Are you an experienced System Architect with a passion for intelligent building management systems, industrial automation, and safety-critical applications? At Deerns, you will have the opportunity to work on innovative and challenging projects that contribute to a smarter, safer, and more sustainable future. Read on and discover how you can make an impact. The challenge The System Architect for Intelligent Building Management Solutions and Industrial Automation plays a crucial role in designing integrated automation solutions for both buildings and industrial processes. This position involves developing safe, efficient, and future-ready systems that connect various installations, such as HVAC, lighting, access control, gas safety, and industrial process control. You will work closely with project teams, suppliers, and end-users to create innovative and sustainable solutions that meet the highest safety standards. Your responsibilities include: Developing automation architectures: Design scalable solutions for intelligent building management and process automation, including gas detection systems, safety mechanisms, and process control. System integration: Connect installations using protocols like BACnet, Modbus, KNX, and industrial standards such as OPC UA and PROFIBUS. Gas safety and process safety: Develop solutions for gas detection, emergency shutdowns, ventilation integration, and fail-safe control systems for industrial environments.
